# purr

Nix flake framework based on directory layout, namespaces, and modules

- [purr](/index): Nix flake framework based on directory layout, namespaces, and modules
- [flake-parts Integration](/flake-parts): Using purr as a flake-parts module
- [mkFlake Usage](/mkflake): Using purr standalone with mkFlake
- [Module System](/modules): Module discovery, namespace support, and custom lib
- [Directory Structure](/directory-structure): Directory layout discovered by purr
- [Systems & Homes](/systems-homes): Discover NixOS/darwin systems and home-manager homes
- [Host Meta](/meta): Per-host metadata exposed as `purr.meta`
- [hydraJobs](/hydrajobs): Hydra CI job sets built from flake outputs and a jobs directory
- [API Reference](/api): purr library API reference
